title: 第15章 枫叶城堡第16章 写信
slug: 落魄贵族千金被迫成为我的女仆
lines: ：随着天色渐暗，城堡内墙壁上的油灯也被女仆们纷纷点亮，虽然没有白天的阳光明亮，但也是颇有一种别样的氛围。
“刚才带你去逛的是后面的花园，接下来就是城堡内部了。”
蒂芙尼迈着小步子，在前面蹦蹦跳跳的带路，还时不时的倒着走路和琉璃川千代面对面。
“你这样倒着走路真的不会摔倒吗？”
琉璃川千代有些忧心地看着蒂芙尼，从小到大都接受贵族礼仪培养的她哪见过这样活泼的女生，果然就和艾莎夫人说的一样，一点也不淑女。
不过……
和蒂芙尼待在一起还挺舒心的。
琉璃川千代不禁想起了刚才在花园里的经历，她们俩居然就在那荡了一个多小时秋千。
明明说是去熟悉环境，结果时间全泡在花园里了。
“放心好啦，我对城堡内的环境可是相当熟悉。”
蒂芙尼一边倒着走路一边十分自信的摆手说道。
蒂芙尼说得正得意，脚下却突然一空。
她正站在通往二楼回廊的旋转楼梯口，那里有一级被地毯遮得不太明显的矮阶。
蒂芙尼平时蹦蹦跳跳惯了，根本没把这级台阶放在眼里，可今天她一边倒着走、一边还夸张地张开双臂比划“本小姐对城堡了如指掌”
，重心完全偏了。
少女短促的惊呼刚出口，整个人便向后仰倒。
楼梯虽不高，但后面就是一整段硬石台阶，只要脑袋磕一下，今晚就得让医师来放血了。
这年头的医师除了会用些草药，别的技能也就只剩下放血了。
琉璃川千代几乎是下意识地伸手。
蒂芙尼被她拉得猛地向前一扑，整个人撞进琉璃川千代的怀里。
少女柔软的发梢扫过千代的下巴，带着淡淡的玫瑰牛奶香。
“千、千代姐姐……？”
蒂芙尼愣了半秒，才意识到自己差点就摔惨了。
不过她转瞬间就把自己差点摔倒的事情给忘在了脑后，一脸兴奋的问道：“你力气好大啊，是不是也修炼过呼吸法。”
琉璃川千代犹豫了一下，还是如实说道：“是有修炼过呼吸法，不过没有和你一样参加骑士训练。”
对于这些大贵族来说，呼吸法并不是什么特别珍贵的东西，自然也不会限制家中子女的修炼。
只不过由于社会环境的影响，很少有贵族女子愿意年复一年的把时间花在这个上面而已。
毕竟在大骑士之前，呼吸法除了能提升身体素质以外没有任何好处。
还不如把时间放在人际交往与贵族宴会上呢，为自己挑一个好的夫婿可比提升一点身体素质重要多了。
“那你觉醒生命种子了吗？”
蒂芙尼身体微微前倾，眨着大眼睛问道。
“嗯，已经觉醒了。”
琉璃川千代微微点头，虽然并没有怎么努力修炼，但她似乎在呼吸法的修行上有着一定天赋，已经觉醒生命种子成为正式骑士了。
蒂芙尼顿时眼泪汪汪：“那为什么我到现在都还没能觉醒生命种子，明明我每天都在修炼呼吸法，我要到什么时候才能成为正式骑士啊。”
content_en:
: As the sky gets darker, the oil lamps on the walls of the castle are also lit by the maids. Although it is not as bright as the sunlight during the day, it still has a different atmosphere.
"I just took you to visit the garden at the back, and the next step is the inside of the castle."
Tiffany took small steps and skipped ahead to lead the way, and walked backwards from time to time to face Rurigawa Chiyo.
"Is it true that you won't fall if you walk backwards like this?"
Rurigawa Chiyo looked at Tiffany with some worry. She had been trained in aristocratic etiquette since she was a child. She had never seen such a lively girl. As expected, just like Mrs. Elsa said, she was not ladylike at all.
But...
It's quite pleasant to be with Tiffany.
Rurigawa Chiyo couldn't help but think of her experience in the garden just now, where the two of them actually swung on the swing for more than an hour.
I said I was going to get familiar with the environment, but I ended up spending all my time in the garden.
"Don't worry, I'm quite familiar with the environment in the castle."
Tiffany waved her hands very confidently while walking backwards.
Tiffany was speaking proudly, but her feet suddenly became empty.
She was standing at the entrance of the spiral staircase leading to the corridor on the second floor. There was a low step that was obscured by the carpet.
Tiffany was used to jumping around and didn't pay attention to this step at all, but today she walked backwards and opened her arms in an exaggerated gesture, "I know the castle well."
, the center of gravity is completely off.
"Yeah-!"
As soon as the girl's short exclamation came out, she fell backwards.
Although the stairs are not high, there is a whole set of hard stone steps behind it. If you hit your head even once, you will have to ask the doctor to do bloodletting tonight.
In addition to using some herbal medicine, doctors these days only have bloodletting skills.
Rurigawa Chiyo stretched out her hand almost subconsciously.
Tiffany was pulled forward by her and slammed into the arms of Rurikawa Chiyo.
The girl's soft hair swept across Chiyo's chin, carrying a faint scent of rose milk.
"Chi-Chiyo sister...?"
Tiffany was stunned for half a second before she realized that she almost fell miserably.
However, she forgot about her almost falling in an instant, and asked excitedly: "You are so strong, have you also practiced breathing techniques?"
Rurigawa Chiyo hesitated for a moment, then said truthfully: "I have practiced breathing techniques, but I have not participated in knight training like you."
For these nobles, the breathing method is not a particularly precious thing, and naturally it will not restrict the practice of their children at home.
It's just that due to the influence of the social environment, few aristocratic women are willing to spend time on this year after year.
After all, before the Great Knight, breathing techniques had no benefits other than improving physical fitness.
It is better to focus on interpersonal communication and noble banquets. Picking a good husband for yourself is much more important than improving your physical fitness.
"Then have you awakened the life seed?"
Tiffany leaned forward slightly and blinked her big eyes and asked.
"Well, I'm already awake."
Rurigawa Chiyo nodded slightly. Although she didn't practice very hard, she seemed to have a certain talent in the practice of breathing method, and she had awakened the seed of life and became an official knight.
"Woo..."
Tiffany suddenly burst into tears: "Then why haven't I awakened the seed of life yet? I'm obviously practicing breathing every day. When can I become an official knight?"
"Uh."
